title: Ijwi Ryahamagara Ubugororotsi .
intro: Mu gihugu ca kera ca Midiyani, aho ubudandaji bwari buteye imbere, n’imigwi y’abantu ikagenda mu bugaragwa bunini, umuhanuzi wa Allah yarahagurutse mu bantu bari barazimiye bava mu nzira y’ubutungane. Uwo musuku wa Allah yarungitswe n’ubutumwa bw’Imana bwo kugerageza ukwizera kw’umuryango wose. Biciye mu bigeragezo vy’ukwihangana n’ukwihangana, uwo mutima warahagaze ushikamye mu gutanga imburi izosubiramwo muri kahise. Woba ushobora guhishura akabanga k’iyo ntumwa ishikamye?
clues: Natowe na Allah kugira ngo ndobore abantu bari bibagiwe ingingo ngenderwako z’ubutungane n’ubugororotsi mu migenderanire yabo.
Nashikirije ubutumwa buhamagara umuryango wanje ngo ntibasenge uwundi atari Allah kandi ngo bavuge ukuri mu bintu vyose.
Naragabishije canecane ku bijanye n’ingeso mbi yo gukoresha ubutunzi biciye mu buryo butemewe n’amategeko, kandi ndashimika ku kamaro k’ibipimo n’ingero bibereye.
Abantu banje barishuye ku ngabisho zanje mu gutwenga, bakantera ubwoba ko bazonyirukana mu gihugu cabo nimbandanya ubutumwa bwanje.
Nagumye nshikamye mu butumwa bwanje naho bari urwanko, nmenyesha ko impembo yanje iri kuri Allah wenyene.
Abantu banje bafashwe n’igihano gikomeye mu gihe jewe nakijijwe n’ikigongwe c’Umukama wanje, uko ubutumwa bwanje bwarangutse.

location.label: Ikintu nyamukuru
options: Igihugu c’i Midiyani, aho abantu banje bakorera ubucuruzi bwabo n’ubucuruzi bwabo .
Ibaraza ry’ubwato bunini bwarokoye abemera umwuzure w’agahomerabunwa .
Isenga ryari ku musozi w’ibitandara aho abasore indwi barondeye ubuhungiro kugira ngo ntibahamirwe .
Igisagara ceranda ca Yeruzalemu aho najanwa mu rugendo rw'ijoro .
Ingoro y’i Sheba aho ubwami bukomeye bwateguye kwibonera ikimenyetso c’Imana .
location.answer: Igihugu c’i Midiyani, aho abantu banje bakorera ubucuruzi bwabo n’ubucuruzi bwabo .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Abantu banje bafashwe n’igihano giteye ubwoba mu gihe jewe nari nkijijwe, kuko nari naranguye inshingano yanje kuri Allah .
Abakafiri barahindutse inkende uko barenga ku mipaka nyeranda ya Allah .
Abansi banje barakiriye ukwizera bamaze kwibonera uguhinduka kw’igitangaza .
Igihugu carahezagiwe n'imvura nyinshi n'uguterimbere abantu bamaze kwihana .
Naragandaguwe n'abantu banje kubera banse guheba ubutumwa bwanje .
outcome.answer: Abantu banje bafashwe n’igihano giteye ubwoba mu gihe jewe nari nkijijwe, kuko nari naranguye inshingano yanje kuri Allah .
